    rSmithDelayedNipGap_um          : REAL := 80.0;     (* Delayed internal reference nip gap estimate [um] *)
    rArealDensityError_gm2          : REAL := 0.0;      (* X-ray density deviation from target [g/m2] *)
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Cascaded outer-loop thickness trim demand [um] *)
    rArealDensityTrim_Integ         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Outer-loop density integral accumulator *)

    (* ============================================================================================= *)
    (* 8.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION MATRICES                   *)
    (* State vector x:                                                                               *)
    (*   x[1] = OS Gap Tracking Error [um]                                                           *)
    (*   x[2] = DS Gap Tracking Error [um]                                                           *)
    (*   x[3] = Roll Bending Profile Deflection Error [um]                                           *)
    (*   x[4] = Differential Thermal Crown Tracking Error [um]                                       *)
    (*   x[5] = Web Tension Micro-Oscillation Perturbation [N]                                       *)
    (*   x[6] = Inline Compacted Areal Density Error [g/m2]                                          *)
    (* Control input vector u:                                                                       *)
    (*   u[1] = OS Servo Valve Command [%]                                                           *)

    A_mat                           : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Discrete state transition matrix A (6x6) *)
    B_mat                           : ARRAY[1..6, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete input coupling matrix B (6x4) *)
    C_mat                           : ARRAY[1..6, 1..6] OF REAL; (* Output observation matrix C (6x6) *)
    D_mat                           : ARRAY[1..6, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Direct feedthrough matrix D (6x4) *)
    x_state                         : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Current estimated state vector *)
    x_pred                          : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* One-step-ahead predicted state vector *)
    x_ref                           : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Target setpoint reference vector *)
    x_err                           : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* Tracking error vector (x_state - x_ref) *)
    u_mpc                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Current MPC control input vector *)
    u_delta                         : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Optimized control increment vector *)
    u_prev                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Previous cycle control input vector *)
    Q_diag                          : ARRAY[1..6] OF REAL;       (* State tracking penalty weights *)
    R_diag                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Control move rate suppression weights *)
    grad_J                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Quadratic cost function gradient vector *)
    H_diag                          : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Approximate Hessian diagonal scaling *)
    bMatricesInitialized           : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Discrete state space matrices primed flag *)

    (* Loop index iterators for matrix operations *)

    rServoFlowLinearGain_DS         : REAL := 1.0;      (* Hydraulic spool square-root pressure drop factor DS *)
    rDeadbandThreshold_pct          : REAL := 1.25;     (* Mechanical valve overlap deadband threshold [%] *)

    rCylinderAreaRatio              : REAL := 1.8000;   (* Cap-to-rod asymmetric hydraulic area ratio *)

    rTempCalc3                      : REAL := 0.0;

    rTargetSeparatingForceSafe_kN   : REAL := 1850.0;
    bInterlockShutdown              : BOOL := FALSE;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS           : BOOL := FALSE;

(* === MAIN LOGIC EXECUTION BODY                                                             === *)

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Reset trip latch registers *)
bInterlockShutdown := FALSE;
dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
rHydraulicDumpValve_FastOpen := FALSE;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low Emergency Shutdown Relay (SIL-3 Hardwired Circuit) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: E-Stop Activated *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Enable Master Permissive Lost *)
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master Enable Permissive Dropped *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Mechanical Roll Collision Guard (Gap < 25.0 um under high force) *)
IF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um < c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um) OR 
    (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um < c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um)) AND 
   ((rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN) > 500.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Critical Mechanical Nip Collision Imminent *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Extreme Separating Force Overload (Load > 3600.0 kN - Frame Yield Hazard) *)
IF (rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN) > c_MaxLineSeparatingForce_kN THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Extreme Mill Structural Separating Overload *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Hydraulic Main Header Depressurization (< 160.0 bar while in high-load nip) *)
IF (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar < 160.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Main Hydraulic Supply Collapse *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: Induction Roll Surface Thermal Runaway (> 205.0 deg C - PTFE Degradation Hazard) *)
IF (rRollSurfaceTemp_Center_DegC > 205.0) OR 
   (rRollSurfaceTemp_OS_Edge_DegC > 205.0) OR 
   (rRollSurfaceTemp_DS_Edge_DegC > 205.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Induction Roll Extreme Thermal Runaway *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: Roll Chock Bearing Overtemperature (> 85.0 deg C - Bearing Seizure Hazard) *)
IF (rChockBearingTemp_OS_DegC > 85.0) OR (rChockBearingTemp_DS_DegC > 85.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Roll Chock Journal Bearing Overheat *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: Excessive Lateral Wedge Taper Deviation (|OS Gap - DS Gap| > 25.0 um under nip) *)
IF (ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um) > 25.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Excessive Nip Wedge Taper Jamming Hazard *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Web Snap / Rupture Under Tension (Tension < 15.0 N while running > 5 m/min) *)
IF (rWebTension_Infeed_N < 15.0) AND (rWebSpeed_mpm > 5.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Infeed Electrode Web Snap Detected *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.10: Extreme Roll Bending Circuit Overpressure (> 320.0 bar) *)
IF (rBendingPressure_Pos_bar > 320.0) OR (rBendingPressure_Neg_bar > 320.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Roll Bending Hydraulic Overpressure *)
    bInterlockShutdown := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Execute immediate emergency de-energization if any SIL-3 interlock condition tripped *)
IF bInterlockShutdown THEN
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bCalenderInNip := FALSE;
    rHydraulicDumpValve_FastOpen := TRUE;   (* Energize dump cartridge to instantaneously open rolls *)
    rServoValve_OS_pct := -100.0;           (* Retract OS cylinder at maximum slew rate *)
    rServoValve_DS_pct := -100.0;           (* Retract DS cylinder at maximum slew rate *)
    rRollBendingValve_pct := 0.0;           (* Depressurize roll bending jacks *)
    rInductionPowerZone1_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 1 *)
    rInductionPowerZone2_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 2 *)
    rInductionPowerZone3_pct := 0.0;        (* Cut induction generator zone 3 *)
    rWebTensionDrivesTrim_rpm := 0.0;
    iState := 100;                          (* Force transition directly to FAULT_RETRACT state *)
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Diagnostic warning register clear *)
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
bWarningActive := FALSE;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 Operator Side (OS) Nip Gap Sensor Voting Bank (Sensors OS_A, OS_B, OS_C)                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um);
rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um);
rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um - rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um);

bGap_OS_SensorFault_A := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));
bGap_OS_SensorFault_B := (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5));
bGap_OS_SensorFault_C := (rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_OS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_OS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));

iGap_OS_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_A THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_OS_SensorFault_C THEN iGap_OS_HealthyCount := iGap_OS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um)) OR 
       ((rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um;
    ELSIF ((rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um)) OR 
          ((rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := FALSE;
ELSIF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Average of the two surviving healthy channels *)
    IF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_A AND NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B AND NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_C THEN
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_OS_um := (rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Warning: OS Gap Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSIF iGap_OS_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single surviving channel fallback *)
    IF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_A THEN rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_A_um;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_OS_SensorFault_B THEN rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_B_um;
    ELSE rVotedGap_OS_um := rNipGapSensor_OS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapOS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Warning: OS Gap Sensor Degraded to Single Channel *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total voting bank failure: Trip immediately *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* Trip: All OS Gap Sensors Failed *)
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.2 Drive Side (DS) Nip Gap Sensor Voting Bank (Sensors DS_A, DS_B, DS_C)                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um);
rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um);
rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um := ABS(rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um - rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um);

bGap_DS_SensorFault_A := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));
bGap_DS_SensorFault_B := (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_AB_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5));
bGap_DS_SensorFault_C := (rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um < 5.0) OR (rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um > 500.0) OR 
                         ((rGap_DS_Dev_BC_um > 2.5) AND (rGap_DS_Dev_CA_um > 2.5));

iGap_DS_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_A THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bGap_DS_SensorFault_C THEN iGap_DS_HealthyCount := iGap_DS_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um)) OR 
       ((rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um;
    ELSIF ((rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um)) OR 
          ((rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um >= rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) AND (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um <= rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um)) THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := FALSE;
ELSIF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_A AND NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B AND NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_C THEN
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedGap_DS_um := (rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um + rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Warning: DS Gap Sensor Degraded to 1oo2 *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSIF iGap_DS_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_A THEN rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_A_um;
    ELSIF NOT bGap_DS_SensorFault_B THEN rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_B_um;
    ELSE rVotedGap_DS_um := rNipGapSensor_DS_C_um;
    END_IF;
    bGracefulDegradeGapDS := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Warning: DS Gap Sensor Degraded to Single Channel *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Trip: All DS Gap Sensors Failed *)
    bMajorFault := TRUE;
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.3 Hydraulic Main Cylinder Pressure Transducers Plausibility Evaluation                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF ABS(rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar - rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar) > 12.0 THEN
    bPress_OS_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    rVotedMainPress_OS_bar := MAX(rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar, rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar); (* Failsafe high *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Warning: OS Cylinder Pressure Discrepancy *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bPress_OS_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    rVotedMainPress_OS_bar := (rMainCylinderPress_OS_A_bar + rMainCylinderPress_OS_B_bar) * 0.50;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar - rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar) > 12.0 THEN
    bPress_DS_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    rVotedMainPress_DS_bar := MAX(rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar, rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar); (* Failsafe high *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Warning: DS Cylinder Pressure Discrepancy *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bPress_DS_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    rVotedMainPress_DS_bar := (rMainCylinderPress_DS_A_bar + rMainCylinderPress_DS_B_bar) * 0.50;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 INDUCTION ROLL THERMAL EXPANSION CROWN ESTIMATION & TIMOSHENKO BEAM BENDING               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.1 Digital Low-Pass Filtering of Induction Pyrometer Array                                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFilteredTempCenter_DegC := rFilteredTempCenter_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_Center_DegC - rFilteredTempCenter_DegC);
rFilteredTempOS_DegC := rFilteredTempOS_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_OS_Edge_DegC - rFilteredTempOS_DegC);
rFilteredTempDS_DegC := rFilteredTempDS_DegC + 
    rThermalFilterAlpha * (rRollSurfaceTemp_DS_Edge_DegC - rFilteredTempDS_DegC);

(* Calculate axial differential temperature gradient (center crown vs edge heat sink) *)
rAxialThermalGradient_DegC := rFilteredTempCenter_DegC - ((rFilteredTempOS_DegC + rFilteredTempDS_DegC) * 0.50);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.2 Dynamic 2D Thermo-Elastic Expansion Model                                                 *)
(* Radial expansion at any axial coordinate z: delta_R(z) = R_0 * alpha * (T(z) - T_ambient)     *)
(* Center-to-edge differential thermal crown: Delta_Crown_therm = delta_R(0) - delta_R(L/2)      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rThermalCenterRadiusGrowth_um := c_RollRadius_um * c_RollSteelThermalExp_perK * 
                                 (rFilteredTempCenter_DegC - rAmbientTemp_DegC);
rThermalEdgeRadiusGrowth_um   := c_RollRadius_um * c_RollSteelThermalExp_perK * 
                                 (((rFilteredTempOS_DegC + rFilteredTempDS_DegC) * 0.50) - rAmbientTemp_DegC);

(* Net differential thermal crown expanding into the nip gap at roll center [um] *)
rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um := rThermalCenterRadiusGrowth_um - rThermalEdgeRadiusGrowth_um;
rThermalExpansionCrown_um      := rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.3 Elastic Beam Deflection Mechanics (Timoshenko Fourth-Order Equation)                      *)
(* Roll barrel behaves as an elastic cylindrical beam under line load q [N/mm]                   *)
(* Line load q = TotalForce / StripWidth                                                         *)
(* Sag deflection at roll centerline: w_sag = (5 * q * L^4) / (384 * E * I)                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTotalSeparatingForce_kN := rCylinderForce_OS_kN + rCylinderForce_DS_kN;

IF rStripWidth_mm > 100.0 THEN
    rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm := (rTotalSeparatingForce_kN * 1000.0) / rStripWidth_mm;
ELSE
    rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Pure mechanical beam bending center sag [um] calculated from line load and steel inertia *)
(* Empirical conversion factor tuned for 750 mm dia x 1100 mm barrel roll: 0.0142 um / (N/mm) *)
rCalculatedElasticDeflect_um := rDynamicLineLoad_Nmm * 0.01425;

(* Net required crown correction: Elastic beam bending tends to open center;                     *)
(* Thermal crown tends to pinch center. The hydraulic roll-bending system must supply the net!   *)
rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um := rCalculatedElasticDeflect_um - (2.0 * rThermalExpansionCrown_um);
rActualRollBendingCrown_um     := (rBendingPressure_Pos_bar - rBendingPressure_Neg_bar) * 0.1250; (* [um/bar] *)

(* Target hydraulic roll bending pressure required to enforce uniform flat nip profile *)
rTargetBendingPressure_bar := 120.0 + (rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um * 4.80);
rTargetBendingPressure_bar := LIMIT(20.0, rTargetBendingPressure_bar, 280.0);

(* Closed-loop Roll Bending PI Regulator *)
rBendingHydraulicError_bar := rTargetBendingPressure_bar - rBendingPressure_Pos_bar;
rBending_PID_Integ := rBending_PID_Integ + (rBendingHydraulicError_bar * 0.150 * c_CycleTime_s);
rBending_PID_Integ := LIMIT(-25.0, rBending_PID_Integ, 25.0);

rRollBendingValve_pct := (rBendingHydraulicError_bar * 1.85) + rBending_PID_Integ + (rTargetBendingPressure_bar * 0.22);
rRollBendingValve_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rRollBendingValve_pct, 100.0);
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 WEB TENSION MICRO-OSCILLATION DECOUPLING & HARMONIC REJECTION                             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.1 Roll Rotational Frequency Calculation & Adaptive Resonant Tracking                        *)
(* Roll angular frequency: omega = v_web / R_roll; f_0 = v_web / (pi * D_roll)                  *)
(* For Dia 750 mm (circumference 2.356 m), at 60 m/min, f_0 = 0.424 Hz                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rWebSpeed_mpm > 0.50 THEN
    rRollRotationalFreq_Hz := (rWebSpeed_mpm / 60.0) / (3.14159265 * (c_RollDiameter_mm * 0.001));
ELSE
    rRollRotationalFreq_Hz := 0.01;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.2 Second-Order Active Band-Stop Notch Filter on Infeed Web Tension Feedback                 *)
(* Eliminates periodic tension oscillations induced by roll eccentricity (TIR runout)            *)
(* State-space direct form II realization of resonant bandstop filter                            *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTensionTrackingError_N := rTargetWebTension_N - rWebTension_Infeed_N;

(* Discrete resonant filter integrator updates *)
rTensionNotchState1 := rTensionNotchState1 + 
    c_CycleTime_s * (rTensionTrackingError_N - (6.28318 * rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz * rTensionNotchState1) - 
    (39.4784 * rRollRotationalFreq_Hz * rRollRotationalFreq_Hz * rTensionNotchState2));
rTensionNotchState2 := rTensionNotchState2 + c_CycleTime_s * rTensionNotchState1;

rFilteredWebTension_N := rWebTension_Infeed_N + (rTensionNotchState1 * 0.350);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.3 Web Tension PI Closed-Loop Regulator with Fast Feedforward Speed Decoupling               *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTensionPid_Integral := rTensionPid_Integral + ((rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension_N) * 0.080 * c_CycleTime_s);
rTensionPid_Integral := LIMIT(-15.0, rTensionPid_Integral, 15.0);

rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm := ((rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension_N) * 0.280) + 
                                   rTensionPid_Integral;
rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm := LIMIT(-25.0, rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm, 25.0);
rWebTensionDrivesTrim_rpm       := rTensionDecouplingSpeedTrim_rpm;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 INLINE X-RAY AREAL DENSITY FEEDBACK & SMITH PREDICTOR (200 - 450 g/m2)                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.1 Dynamic Transport Delay Calculation                                                       *)
(* transit_time tau_d = Distance / LineSpeed; dynamic ring buffer index = tau_d / CycleTime      *)
(* Distance = 3.850 m. At 30 m/min (0.5 m/s), tau_d = 7.7 s. Downsampled by factor of 100 ms.   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rWebSpeed_mpm > 2.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := c_XRaySensorDistance_m / (rWebSpeed_mpm / 60.0); (* Transit delay in seconds *)
    iDynamicDelaySteps := REAL_TO_INT(rTempCalc1 * 10.0);          (* Delay buffer sampled at 100 ms *)
    iDynamicDelaySteps := LIMIT(2, iDynamicDelaySteps, 125);
ELSE
    iDynamicDelaySteps := 125;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.2 Circular Ring Buffer FIFO Management for Smith Delay Compensation                         *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
iDelayBufferWriteIndex := (iDelayBufferWriteIndex + 1) MOD 128;
rXRayDelayBuffer[iDelayBufferWriteIndex] := (rVotedGap_OS_um + rVotedGap_DS_um) * 0.50;

(* Retrieve delayed model gap estimate corresponding to the exact web slice at X-ray head *)
rTempCalc2 := INT_TO_REAL((iDelayBufferWriteIndex - iDynamicDelaySteps + 128) MOD 128);
rSmithDelayedNipGap_um := rXRayDelayBuffer[REAL_TO_INT(rTempCalc2)];
rSmithModelNipGap_um   := (rVotedGap_OS_um + rVotedGap_DS_um) * 0.50;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.3 Dry Electrode Calendering Compacted Density & Bulk Porosity Estimation                    *)
(* Compacted Density rho_c [g/cm3] = ArealDensity [g/m2] / NipGap [um]                           *)
(* Bulk Porosity eps [%] = (1.0 - (rho_c / rho_theoretical)) * 100.0 %                          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rActualMeanNipGap_um := ((rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um) + 
                         (rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um)) * 0.50;
rActualNipTaper_um   := (rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um) - 
                         (rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um);

IF rActualMeanNipGap_um > 10.0 THEN
    rCompactedArealDensity_Est_gm2 := rTargetArealDensity_gm2; (* Nominal base *)
    rTempCalc3 := (rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2 / rActualMeanNipGap_um); (* [g/cm3 equivalent] *)
    IF rTheoreticalSolidDensity_gcm3 > 0.10 THEN
        rEstimatedPorosity_pct := (1.0 - (rTempCalc3 / rTheoreticalSolidDensity_gcm3)) * 100.0;
        rEstimatedPorosity_pct := LIMIT(5.0, rEstimatedPorosity_pct, 60.0);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.4 Smith Predictor Outer-Loop Areal Density Trim Regulator                                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bXRayDataValid AND (iState = 70) THEN
    bGracefulDegradeXRay := FALSE;
    rArealDensityError_gm2 := rTargetArealDensity_gm2 - rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2;
    
    (* Integrating trim regulator with anti-windup *)
    rArealDensityTrim_Integ := rArealDensityTrim_Integ + 
                               (rArealDensityError_gm2 * 0.0045 * c_CycleTime_s);
    rArealDensityTrim_Integ := LIMIT(-8.0, rArealDensityTrim_Integ, 8.0);
    
    (* Sensitivity of dry electrode: ~3.8 g/m2 density shift per 1.0 um gap adjustment *)
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := (rArealDensityError_gm2 * 0.263) + rArealDensityTrim_Integ;
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := LIMIT(-12.0, rDensityTrimGapOffset_um, 12.0);
ELSE
    (* Fallback to open-loop feedforward when X-ray data invalid or scanning off-sheet *)
    bGracefulDegradeXRay := TRUE;
    rDensityTrimGapOffset_um := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Warning: Inline X-Ray Feedback Suspended *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE (A,B,C,D) & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 Initialize Discrete State-Space Model Matrices (Sampled at Ts = 1.0 ms)                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Diagonal state self-decay and coupling *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9850; A_mat[1,2] := 0.0085; A_mat[1,3] :=-0.0120; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0210; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0015; A_mat[1,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[2,1] := 0.0085; A_mat[2,2] := 0.9850; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0120; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0210; A_mat[2,5] :=-0.0015; A_mat[2,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[3,1] :=-0.0150; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0150; A_mat[3,3] := 0.9620; A_mat[3,4] :=-0.0350; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 0.9992; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0450; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0450; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.9450; A_mat[5,6] := 0.0;
    A_mat[6,1] := 0.0820; A_mat[6,2] := 0.0820; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0150; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := 0.0020; A_mat[6,6] := 0.9910;

    (* Input control matrix B (6 states x 4 inputs) *)
    B_mat[1,1] := 0.0420; B_mat[1,2] := 0.0015; B_mat[1,3] :=-0.0045; B_mat[1,4] := 0.0005;
    B_mat[2,1] := 0.0015; B_mat[2,2] := 0.0420; B_mat[2,3] := 0.0045; B_mat[2,4] := 0.0005;
    B_mat[3,1] :=-0.0080; B_mat[3,2] := 0.0080; B_mat[3,3] := 0.0580; B_mat[3,4] :=-0.0020;
    B_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,4] := 0.0085;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.0180; B_mat[5,2] := 0.0180; B_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[6,1] := 0.0250; B_mat[6,2] := 0.0250; B_mat[6,3] := 0.0035; B_mat[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Output matrix C (Identity 6x6) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0; ELSE C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0; END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Feedthrough matrix D (Zero 6x4) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO D_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0; END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Quadratic cost functional weights: Q (State tracking) and R (Input rates) *)
    Q_diag[1] := 15.0;  (* OS Gap Error Priority *)
    Q_diag[2] := 15.0;  (* DS Gap Error Priority *)
    Q_diag[3] := 8.50;  (* Roll Bending Camber Priority *)
    Q_diag[4] := 5.20;  (* Thermal Crown Stability *)
    Q_diag[5] := 3.40;  (* Web Tension Micro-damping *)
    Q_diag[6] := 12.0;  (* Inline Areal Density Compaction *)

    R_diag[1] := 0.85;  (* OS Servo Valve Energy *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.85;  (* DS Servo Valve Energy *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.65;  (* Roll-Bending Valve Slew *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.45;  (* Induction Power Smoothness *)

    (* Diagonal approximation of Hessian matrix H = 2 * (B' * Q * B + R) *)
    H_diag[1] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,1]*B_mat[1,1]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,1]*B_mat[2,1]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,1]*B_mat[3,1]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[5,1]*B_mat[5,1]*Q_diag[5]) + 
                        (B_mat[6,1]*B_mat[6,1]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[1]);
    H_diag[2] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,2]*B_mat[1,2]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,2]*B_mat[2,2]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,2]*B_mat[3,2]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[5,2]*B_mat[5,2]*Q_diag[5]) + 
                        (B_mat[6,2]*B_mat[6,2]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[2]);
    H_diag[3] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[1,3]*B_mat[1,3]*Q_diag[1]) + (B_mat[2,3]*B_mat[2,3]*Q_diag[2]) + 
                        (B_mat[3,3]*B_mat[3,3]*Q_diag[3]) + (B_mat[6,3]*B_mat[6,3]*Q_diag[6]) + R_diag[3]);
    H_diag[4] := 2.0 * ((B_mat[4,4]*B_mat[4,4]*Q_diag[4]) + R_diag[4]);

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.2 Populate State and Reference Vectors                                                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
x_state[1] := rVotedGap_OS_um - rTareOffset_OS_um;
x_state[2] := rVotedGap_DS_um - rTareOffset_DS_um;
x_state[3] := rActualRollBendingCrown_um;
x_state[4] := rThermalExpansionCrownModel_um;
x_state[5] := rFilteredWebTension_N;
x_state[6] := rXRayArealDensity_Scan_gm2;

rSafeNipSetpoint_um := LIMIT(c_MinPermissibleNipGap_um, 
                             rNipGapSetpoint_um + rDensityTrimGapOffset_um, 
                             c_MaxPermissibleNipGap_um);

x_ref[1] := rSafeNipSetpoint_um;
x_ref[2] := rSafeNipSetpoint_um;
x_ref[3] := rNetRequiredCrownCorrection_um;
x_ref[4] := 22.0; (* Baseline equilibrium thermal expansion crown *)
x_ref[5] := rTargetWebTension_N;
x_ref[6] := rTargetArealDensity_gm2;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.3 State One-Step Ahead Forward Prediction: x_pred = A * x + B * u                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempCalc1 := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempCalc1 := rTempCalc1 + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_prev[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iRow] := rTempCalc1;
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.4 Real-Time Quadratic Cost Function Gradient Computation & Projected Descent Iteration      *)
(* Cost: J = sum(x_err' * Q * x_err) + sum(u' * R * u)                                           *)
(* Gradient: grad_J = 2 * B' * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + 2 * R * u                                 *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMpcObjectiveCost := 0.0;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rMpcObjectiveCost := rMpcObjectiveCost + (x_err[iRow] * x_err[iRow] * Q_diag[iRow]);
END_FOR;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMpcObjectiveCost := rMpcObjectiveCost + (u_prev[iRow] * u_prev[iRow] * R_diag[iRow]);
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Gradient vector for each of the 4 control inputs *)
FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempCalc2 := 0.0;
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempCalc2 := rTempCalc2 + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]));
    END_FOR;
    grad_J[iCol] := (2.0 * rTempCalc2) + (2.0 * R_diag[iCol] * u_prev[iCol]);
END_FOR;

(* Perform 3 Fast Newton-Raphson / Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Steps *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF H_diag[iCol] > 0.001 THEN
            rGradStep := grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol];
        ELSE
            rGradStep := grad_J[iCol] * 0.010;
        END_IF;
        u_delta[iCol] := -1.0 * rGradStep;
        u_mpc[iCol]   := u_prev[iCol] + u_delta[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Box Constraints and Actuator Saturation Limits *)
    u_mpc[1] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[1], 100.0); (* OS Servo Valve % *)
    u_mpc[2] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[2], 100.0); (* DS Servo Valve % *)
    u_mpc[3] := LIMIT(-100.0, u_mpc[3], 100.0); (* Roll Bending Valve % *)
    u_mpc[4] := LIMIT(-30.0,  u_mpc[4], 30.0);  (* Center Zone Induction Trim % *)

    (* Refresh previous vector for subsequent step *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        u_prev[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 SERVO VALVE NON-LINEARITIES & ASYMMETRIC HYDRAULIC COMPENSATION                          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.1 Pressure-Drop Flow Linearization (Orifice Equation Q = C_d * A * sqrt(Delta_P))          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar > (rVotedMainPress_OS_bar + 10.0) THEN
    rServoFlowLinearGain_OS := SQRT(150.0 / (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar - rVotedMainPress_OS_bar));
ELSE
    rServoFlowLinearGain_OS := 1.50;
END_IF;
rServoFlowLinearGain_OS := LIMIT(0.70, rServoFlowLinearGain_OS, 2.20);

IF rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar > (rVotedMainPress_DS_bar + 10.0) THEN
    rServoFlowLinearGain_DS := SQRT(150.0 / (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar - rVotedMainPress_DS_bar));
ELSE
    rServoFlowLinearGain_DS := 1.50;
END_IF;
rServoFlowLinearGain_DS := LIMIT(0.70, rServoFlowLinearGain_DS, 2.20);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.2 Spool Overlap Deadband Compensation & Asymmetric Cylinder Area Gain                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF iState = 70 THEN
    (* Closed loop production calendering: blend MPC command with non-linear hydraulic mapping *)
    rTempCalc1 := u_mpc[1] * rServoFlowLinearGain_OS;
    IF rTempCalc1 > 0.05 THEN
        rServoValve_OS_pct := rTempCalc1 + rDeadbandThreshold_pct;
    ELSIF rTempCalc1 < -0.05 THEN
        rServoValve_OS_pct := (rTempCalc1 * rCylinderAreaRatio) - rDeadbandThreshold_pct;
    ELSE
        rServoValve_OS_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    rTempCalc2 := u_mpc[2] * rServoFlowLinearGain_DS;
    IF rTempCalc2 > 0.05 THEN
        rServoValve_DS_pct := rTempCalc2 + rDeadbandThreshold_pct;
    ELSIF rTempCalc2 < -0.05 THEN
        rServoValve_DS_pct := (rTempCalc2 * rCylinderAreaRatio) - rDeadbandThreshold_pct;
    ELSE
        rServoValve_DS_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Clamp servo valve demand *)
rServoValve_OS_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rServoValve_OS_pct, 100.0);
rServoValve_DS_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rServoValve_DS_pct, 100.0);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTI-ZONE INDUCTION HEATING THERMAL CONTROLLER (180.0 deg C)                             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Independent 3-Zone Thermal PID Governors with Center-to-Edge Cross-Coupling Decoupling        *)
(* Zone 1: Operator Side Edge (Heats edge roll shoulder to minimize conduction sink to chock)   *)
(* Zone 2: Center Body (Controls primary bulk temperature and dynamic thermal expansion crown)   *)
(* Zone 3: Drive Side Edge (Matches OS shoulder to preserve thermal symmetry)                   *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rInduction_PID_Err_Z1 := (rRollInductionTempSetpoint_DegC - 3.5) - rFilteredTempOS_DegC;
rInduction_PID_Err_Z2 := rRollInductionTempSetpoint_DegC - rFilteredTempCenter_DegC;
rInduction_PID_Err_Z3 := (rRollInductionTempSetpoint_DegC - 3.5) - rFilteredTempDS_DegC;

(* Zone Integrators *)
rInduction_PID_Integ_Z1 := rInduction_PID_Integ_Z1 + (rInduction_PID_Err_Z1 * 0.018 * c_CycleTime_s);
rInduction_PID_Integ_Z1 := LIMIT(0.0, rInduction_PID_Integ_Z1, 100.0);

rInduction_PID_Integ_Z2 := rInduction_PID_Integ_Z2 + (rInduction_PID_Err_Z2 * 0.022 * c_CycleTime_s);
rInduction_PID_Integ_Z2 := LIMIT(0.0, rInduction_PID_Integ_Z2, 100.0);

rInduction_PID_Integ_Z3 := rInduction_PID_Integ_Z3 + (rInduction_PID_Err_Z3 * 0.018 * c_CycleTime_s);
rInduction_PID_Integ_Z3 := LIMIT(0.0, rInduction_PID_Integ_Z3, 100.0);

IF (iState >= 30) AND (iState < 90) AND NOT bInterlockShutdown THEN
    rInductionPowerZone1_pct := (rInduction_PID_Err_Z1 * 4.2) + rInduction_PID_Integ_Z1;
    rInductionPowerZone2_pct := (rInduction_PID_Err_Z2 * 5.0) + rInduction_PID_Integ_Z2 + u_mpc[4];
    rInductionPowerZone3_pct := (rInduction_PID_Err_Z3 * 4.2) + rInduction_PID_Integ_Z3;
ELSE
    rInductionPowerZone1_pct := 0.0;
    rInductionPowerZone2_pct := 0.0;
    rInductionPowerZone3_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

rInductionPowerZone1_pct := LIMIT(0.0, rInductionPowerZone1_pct, 100.0);
rInductionPowerZone2_pct := LIMIT(0.0, rInductionPowerZone2_pct, 100.0);
rInductionPowerZone3_pct := LIMIT(0.0, rInductionPowerZone3_pct, 100.0);
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 9.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluate state entry triggers *)
IF iState <> iPrevState THEN
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    iPrevState := iState;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

iActiveStateNumber := iState;

(* State execution step-timer update *)
tStateTimer(IN := NOT bStateFirstScan, PT := T#24H);

CASE iState OF

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / UNINITIALIZED                                                          *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bCalenderInNip := FALSE;
        rServoValve_OS_pct := 0.0;
        rServoValve_DS_pct := 0.0;
        rRollBendingValve_pct := 0.0;
        rWebTensionDrivesTrim_rpm := 0.0;
        rCalenderMainSpeedRef_mpm := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND NOT bMajorFault THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    10: (* STATE 10: STANDBY & PRE-OPERATIONAL CHECKS                                            *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bCalenderInNip := FALSE;
        rCalenderMainSpeedRef_mpm := 0.0;

        IF bReset THEN
            bMajorFault := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000;
        END_IF;

        (* Advance to Hydraulic Charging when commanded *)
        IF bAutoMode AND bEnable THEN
            iState := 20;
        ELSIF bCalibrationMode THEN
            iState := 40; (* Direct entry into kiss zero calibration *)
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    20: (* STATE 20: HYDRAULIC CHARGING & SERVO BLEED                                            *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rServoValve_OS_pct := -15.0; (* Retract gently to upper mechanical stops *)
        rServoValve_DS_pct := -15.0;
        rRollBendingValve_pct := 15.0; (* Pre-pressurize roll bending lines *)

        tStepWatchdog(IN := (iState = 20), PT := T#15S);

        (* Verify main hydraulic line pressure reaches at least 220 bar *)
        IF (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar >= 220.0) AND (tStateTimer.ET > T#2S) THEN
            tStepWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Advance to thermal induction soak *)
        ELSIF tStepWatchdog.Q THEN
            tStepWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Trip: Hydraulic charge timeout *)
            bMajorFault := TRUE;
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    30: (* STATE 30: INDUCTION HEATING THERMAL RAMP & EQUILIBRIUM SOAK                          *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        (* Rotate rolls slowly at 3.0 m/min to prevent localized induction hot spots *)
        rCalenderMainSpeedRef_mpm := 3.0;

        (* Check thermal soak completion (roll center >= 175.0 deg C and crown stabilized) *)
        IF (rFilteredTempCenter_DegC >= (rRollInductionTempSetpoint_DegC - 4.0)) AND 
           (rFilteredTempOS_DegC >= 165.0) AND (rFilteredTempDS_DegC >= 165.0) THEN
            IF bCalibrationComplete THEN
                iState := 50; (* Advance to web threading *)
            ELSE
                iState := 40; (* Perform zero datum kiss calibration *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    40: (* STATE 40: PROFILE KISS-TOUCH ZERO DATUM CALIBRATION                                   *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rCalenderMainSpeedRef_mpm := 0.0; (* Stationary rolls during kissing tare *)

        (* Slowly close cylinders until kiss contact load of 80 kN is achieved *)
        IF (rCylinderForce_OS_kN < 80.0) THEN
            rServoValve_OS_pct := 4.5;
        ELSE
            rServoValve_OS_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;
